annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Observatorio Federal sobre Inteligencia Artificial (O.F.I.A.)
annotation.title_en: Bill: Federal Observatory on Artificial Intelligence (O.F.I.A.)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Silvana Micaela Ginocchio, Diputada Nacional (Catamarca), Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.venue: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill creating a Federal Observatory on Artificial Intelligence within the national Executive. It would gather and publish information, consult experts, evaluate regulation and issue annual reports to support trustworthy, non-discriminatory, rights-respecting AI policy and AI education. Rationale draws on the UNESCO Recommendation and the EU AI Act. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Observatorio Federal sobre IA (O.F.I.A.) under the national Executive.
Functions: analysis of AI risks and ethics, expert consultation, evaluation of regulation, periodic reports, cooperation agreements.
Composed of ministerial, congressional, provincial and university representatives, serving ad honorem, with a director serving two years.
Executive designates the enforcement authority; Ministry of Economy adjusts the budget.
Invites provinces and Buenos Aires City to adhere.
